## Thesis supervision

I supervise bachelor's theses in Applied Economics at Utrecht, most recently a
cohort of ten in 2026.

Topics I am glad to supervise include the evaluation of climate and energy
policy, household energy demand and adoption of low-carbon technologies, and the
distributional consequences of the energy transition. Students with a project of
their own in these areas are welcome to get in touch.
